requirement.summary: Publish the two completed visual tasks as one scoped implementation commit to the configured main Pages source, excluding user configuration. Inspect the intended diff, branch, remotes, and remote divergence; rerun bounded validation and protected hashes; then push normally without force or pull request. Wait for the exact Pages build and verify the live homepage plus both report languages at desktop and phone widths, including document containment and protected bytes. Record the commit, build, online results, and pending real-human comprehension boundary in current status, the dated log, and this task, then push one documentation-only closeout commit. Provide a neutral public-site-only question pack for an unbriefed human, but do not claim the test complete before human answers arrive. No package release, non-Pages deployment, force push, agent-proxy substitution, or product-scope change is authorized.

items: A mixed dirty worktree could stage user configuration or omit one reviewed task slice.

A closeout commit could accidentally include implementation changes.
Reader questions could coach the participant or overstate one response as product validation.
